title: Tarte a l'Oignon
subtitle: An Alsatian cream and onion tart
excerpt: Slowly cooked onions in a barely-set cream and egg custard, baked in a blind-baked shortcrust case. A simple tart that depends entirely on patient onion cooking.
sourceNotes: Alsatian regional speciality, adapted from standard French culinary tradition.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook the onions up to two days ahead and refrigerate. Assemble and bake on the day.

content.text: This Alsatian tart is built on onions cooked low and slow until they are completely soft and golden. The custard is lighter than a quiche and barely sets. Do not rush the onion stage or the filling will taste raw and sharp.
Roll the pastry to 3mm thick and line a 23cm loose-bottomed tart tin. Chill for 30 minutes.

Melt the butter in a large saucepan over a low heat. Add the sliced onions with a pinch of salt. Cook gently for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often, until completely soft and pale golden. Do not let them colour much. Tip into a bowl and cool.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line the pastry case with baking paper and fill with baking beans. Blind bake for 15 minutes. Remove the beans and paper and bake for 5 more minutes until the base is dry.
Whisk the cream, eggs, and egg yolks together. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Spread the cooled onions in an even layer over the pastry base.
Pour the cream mixture slowly over the onions. Place the tin on a baking sheet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble in the middle.
Rest for 10 minutes in the tin before unmoulding. Serve warm or at room temperature.

items.symptom: The filling tastes sharp or raw.
items.cause: The onions were not cooked long enough.
items.fix: Return the onion mixture to the pan and cook for another 10 to 15 minutes over a low heat before assembling.

items.cause: The onions gave off liquid during baking.
items.fix: Drain the cooled onions through a sieve before adding them to the tart case.

items.symptom: The pastry base is pale and underdone.
items.cause: The blind bake was too short.
items.fix: Bake the empty case until it looks visibly dry and beginning to colour at the edges before adding the filling.
